graderOnly: Recovery Frame 1 is From REVIEWING_FINAL, Owner DOCUMENTING, FailureType DOCUMENTATION, ResumeAt REVIEWING_FINAL, RerunThrough SYNCHRONIZING. The current state SYNCHRONIZING is the rerun boundary; Synchronizer does not own the frame (its Owner is DOCUMENTING).

The documentation correction (the guide now says GET /records/export returns 405, which is what the router returns) is complete and verified: the documentation record is COMPLETE with DOC-001 RESOLVED, and the rerun final-deliverable review is COMPLETE with F-001 RESOLVED on the current content.
Implementation, tests, verification, implementation review, documentation, and the final review all agree with the current tree; no material discrepancy exists and the synchronization gate passes.

Correct routing at this boundary: after the gate passes, pop Frame 1 (recovery becomes inactive) and transition to REVIEWING_FINAL with Handoff.Kind RESUME and From SYNCHRONIZING, instead of the normal forward handoff to AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF.
